editor.title: A newspaper written by someone who loves technology.
editor.intro: This space was born from a simple wish: a place of my own to think out loud about technology. Here you'll find three things:
editor.item1: Tech news worth reading — filtered, commented on, and unhurried.
editor.item2: Notes from my studies, shared while I learn, mistakes included.
editor.item3: Essays and opinions on the craft of building software.
editor.closing: All made with love and care for technology — and for anyone who, like me, enjoys understanding how things work. Thanks for reading.
editor.illustrationAlt: Illustration of a desk with a typewriter, a study notebook with a heart, a newspaper and coffee
